history.en: describe a woman who was extremely happy and in love. The number nine later became the standard form.
history.zh: Merriam-Webster 把 cloud nine 表達這種情緒意思的最早已知用法追溯至1936年。 歷史資料亦顯示，美國俚語曾使用多個不同數字的「雲端」表達，包括 cloud seven 和 cloud eight。 1946年的一則連環漫畫曾以 on cloud 9 形容一名因愛情而極度開心的女子。 後來，nine 才逐漸成為固定數字。

history.en: Different numbered clouds were once used to suggest dreaminess, excitement or a state far above ordinary life. Over time, cloud nine became the surviving fixed form and developed the clear modern meaning of extreme happiness.
history.zh: 不同數字的雲端表達曾用來表示夢幻、興奮或遠離平凡生活的狀態。 後來，cloud nine 成為保留下來的固定形式，並逐漸形成今天「極度開心」的明確意思。

origin.memoryEn: Imagine happiness lifting you so high that you feel as though you are standing above the ordinary world on a cloud.
origin.memoryZh: 想像喜悅把你托得很高，令你彷彿站在雲端，遠離平凡世界。
